post.description: Use this API to get recommended shipment quantities for the items that you plan to send to Walmart Fulfillment Services (WFS) in order to achieve optimal inventory levels.

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: Basic authorization header. Base 64 encodes the Client ID and Client Secret retrieved in step two of the integration steps.

parameters.name: WM_SEC.ACCESS_TOKEN
parameters.description: The access token retrieved in the Token API call

parameters.name: WM_CONSUMER.CHANNEL.TYPE
parameters.description: A unique ID to track the consumer request by channel. Use the Consumer Channel Type received during onboarding.

parameters.name: WM_QOS.CORRELATION_ID
parameters.description: A unique ID which identifies each API call and used to track and debug issues; use a random generated GUID for this ID.

parameters.name: WM_SVC.NAME
parameters.description: Walmart Service Name.

parameters.name: Accept
parameters.description: Only supported Media Type : application/json.

parameters.name: WM_GLOBAL_VERSION
parameters.description: Global version for API compatibility.

parameters.name: WM_MARKET
parameters.description: Market identifier.

requestBody.description: Request body containing GTINs or SKUs to retrieve the quantity limit.

listOfGtins.description: List of GTINs to request recommended shipment quantities for.

listOfSkus.description: List of SKUs to request recommended shipment quantities for.

itemId.description: The Walmart-assigned ID used to track items. This ID is located at the end of the item page URL.

gtin.description: The Global Trade Identification Number (GTIN) associated with the item. If you provide a 12-digit UPC rather than a GTIN, the GTIN will start with two 0s followed by the UPC.

upc.description: Universal Product Code (UPC) of the item.

vendorSku.description: The unique identifier assigned to the item by the seller.

maxQty.description: Recommended maximum quantity for the item

customerFavorite.description: Indicates whether the item is identified as a customer favorite based on customer demand.

400.description: Bad Request - Missing required GTIN or SKU

500.description: Internal Server Error - All GTINs are invalid

get.description:
Use **Restock Recommendations** to get Walmart-generated suggestions for the items you should restock with WFS based on your current inventory and forecasted sales demand. These suggestions are available on demand. Key attributes include:

- **suggestedUnits**: The number of units we suggest you send of this item to WFS
- **forecastedSalesLift**: The estimated increase in sales you may see if your items are restocked according to our suggestions
- **totalForecastedSalesLost**: How much money you're estimated to lose out on if you don't restock your inventory

Once you determine which suggested items to restock, you can use the Create inbound shipment API to create a shipping plan to send inventory to WFS.

parameters.description: Specifies the literal **application/json**. This value identifies the content type of the request body.

parameters.description: Only supported Media Type : application/json.

parameters.name: WM_MARKET

parameters.name: wm_audit.origin_source
parameters.description: Seller identifier.

parameters.name: customerFavorite
parameters.description: Filters items by customer favorite status. When set to `true`, only customer favorites are returned. When set to `false`, only non-favorites are returned. If omitted, all items are returned.

parameters.name: showInsights
parameters.description: Shows aggregate recommendation values for all items.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of SKUs to include in the response (1–300). If you omit this parameter, Walmart returns up to 30 SKUs.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The number of SKUs to skip before Walmart starts listing results. Set to 0 to start at the first SKU.

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: The attribute to be used in sorting the response.

parameters.name: sort_order
parameters.description: The order in which the response should be sorted. This can be in set to "ASC" or "DESC" order of value. Default is "DESC.

parameters.name: showHiddenRecordsOnly
parameters.description: Shows insights you have hidden.

gtin.description: The Global Trade Identification Number (GTIN) associated with the item. If you provide a 12-digit UPC rather than a GTIN, the GTIN will start with two 0s followed by the UPC.

sku.description: The unique identifier you as the seller have assigned to your item.

itemId.description: Unique identifier assigned by Walmart for each item.

brand.description: The company name or manufacturer of the item.

stockStatus.description:
Out-of-stock items have 0 units available to sell.
At-risk items have fewer than 28 days of supply, including both available and inbound units.
In-stock items have more than 28 days of total supply.
Long term out of stock items that have been consistently out of stock for more than 30 days.
New to WFS items that have been set up in WFS but haven't been inbounded because a shipment order has not been created.

itemCondition.description: The item's condition described by its appearance, quality, packaging, functionality, and previous usage.

daysOfSupply.description: The anticipated number of days your current available and inbound inventory will last, based on your daily forecasted sales demand.

suggestedUnits.description: The number of units Walmart suggests you send to WFS based on the item's forecasted sales demand. These suggestions are generated by algorithms considering several factors including past sales, seasonality, listing, quality, pricing, and more.

forecastedSalesLift.description: Estimated dollar amount in sales if the suggested number of units are sent to WFS and sold within 8 weeks.

customerFavorite.description: Indicates whether the item is identified as a customer favorite based on customer demand.

totalEstimatedSalesLift.description: Estimated total dollar amount you could lose in sales each day if both out-of-stock and at-risk items are not restocked.

totalForecastedSalesLost.description: Estimated dollar amount you could lose in sales each day if all out-of-stock items are not restocked.

totalForecastedSalesAtRisk.description: Estimated dollar amount you could lose in daily sales if all items with under 4 weeks of supply are not restocked.

totalRecords.description: The total number of item-level restock insights available to you.

get.description:
Use **Fulfill With WFS Recommendations** to identify which seller-fulfilled items in your catalog Walmart suggests could potentially perform best when fulfilled by WFS. These suggestions are available on demand, and suggestions are refreshed the 1st and 15th of each month.

Key attributes include:

- **estimatedSalesLift**: The estimated increase in sales you could see if you converted the suggested items from seller-fulfilled to WFS.

- **sellerFulfilledPast30DaysSales**: A historical view of your seller-fulfilled sales for the past 30 days.
- **walmartFulfilledEstimatedSales**: An estimated view of your potential sales if the suggested items were fulfilled by WFS.

You can use these suggestions to determine which items to convert to WFS.

get.description:
This call helps you identify the estimated storage fees with Walmart for your unpublished WFS items.

Use **Unpublished Recommendations** to fetch a current list of your unpublished WFS items. This is available on demand. 

Key data attributes include:

- **unpublishedIssue**: The reason your item is currently unpublished with Walmart.
- **estimatedStorageFee**: The estimated storage costs associated with your unpublished WFS inventory.
- **totalunpublishedunitsstored**: The total quantity of units in WFS fulfillment centers for unpublished items.

Use this data to identify the reason these items are unpublished and the estimated costs associated with these unpublished items. By default, these suggestions will only include items that are active with an Available to Sell (ATS) quantity of 0.
